sentences.en: Collective rules are not set straightaway but progressively win recognition.
sentences.zh: 集体规则不是一下子就制定出来的，而是逐渐获得认可。

sentences.en: Israel has intensified its collective punishment of the Palestinian people.
sentences.zh: 以色列对巴勒斯坦人民实施了更严厉的集体惩罚。

sentences.en: Role-Language includes male and female collective nouns in Japanese.
sentences.zh: 角色语言包括日语中的男性和女性集合名词。

senses.zh: 集体的；共同的；集合的；集体主义的
